@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.aix import AIXHardware
+
+
+class TestAIXGetCPUFacts(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_smt_processor_facts(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.run_command.side_effect = [
+            (0, 'proc0 Available 00-00 Processor\nproc1 Available 00-01 Processor\nproc2 Defined 00-02 Processor\n', ''),
+            (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+            (0, 'smt_threads 4 SMT threads False\n', ''),
+        ]
+
+        facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+        self.assertEqual(facts, {
+            'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+            'processor_count': 1,
+            'processor_cores': 2,
+            'processor_threads_per_core': 4,
+            'processor_vcpus': 8,
+        })
+
+    def test_missing_smt_defaults_to_one_thread(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.run_command.side_effect = [
+            (0, 'proc0 Available 00-00 Processor\n', ''),
+            (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+            (0, '', ''),
+        ]
+
+        facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+        self.assertEqual(facts['processor_threads_per_core'], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(facts['processor_vcpus'], 1)
+
+    def test_no_available_processors(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'proc0 Defined 00-00 Processor\n', '')
+
+        facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+        self.assertEqual(facts, {
+            'processor': [],
+            'processor_count': 1,
+            'processor_cores': 0,
+            'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+            'processor_vcpus': 0,
+        })
+        module.run_command.assert_called_once_with('/usr/sbin/lsdev -Cc processor')
